title: Robot guidance and picking
lede: Position and pose of parts in bins, totes and on pallets, from one stationary capture. Point clouds and color images from Bigframe application cases; the depalletizing scene is a rendering.
tile1_desc: Grasp points on unsorted parcels from the point cloud
tile2_desc_prefix: Layer height and carton positions from one capture at
tile2_caption: Rendering — PRS over a Euro pallet
tile3_desc: Items segmented by shape, color and print; pick pose per item
tile4_desc: Screws, nuts and washers recognized in a mixed bin
tile5_desc: Parts segmented on the registered color image and picked
cta_body: Send a photograph of the part, the feature to be measured and its tolerance. You receive the recommended model and working distance, and a clear statement of what the camera resolves — before you buy.
